Metadata.title: Web and mobile app development in Slovakia | Ergodic
Metadata.description: Websites, e-shops, mobile apps and automation for businesses in Slovakia and the EU. Out of every possible option, we build the right one.

Hero.titleB: We build the one that’s yours.
Hero.lead: Custom websites, e-shops, mobile apps and automation for companies across Slovakia and abroad. Out of every possible option, we build the right one.
Hero.leadShort: Websites, apps and automation, built to fit. Out of every possible option, we build the right one.
Hero.caption: Paths considered · 1 built

Method.title: You see the options and prices first. Then we build.

survey.title: Survey
survey.body: We meet in Košice or online and find out what you do by hand today and what should change.

variants.title: Options
variants.body: We lay the options side by side, each with a price. If an off-the-shelf service will do, we tell you straight away.

build.title: Build
build.body: We build the chosen option in parts. You can check the work in progress on a test link and comment as it grows.

maintain.title: Support
maintain.body: After launch we keep maintaining and developing it. Or you take it over.

web.title: Websites & e-shops
web.body: Sites and stores that load at once on a phone. In Slovak, English or more languages.
web.specs: Card payments|Several languages|Edit without a developer

mobile.title: Mobile apps
mobile.body: One codebase for iOS and Android, published in both stores.
mobile.specs: iPhone and Android|App Store · Google Play|Notifications · Offline mode

automation.title: Automation & AI
automation.body: We connect your systems so nobody retypes data by hand. AI goes where a mistake shows right away.

care.title: Maintenance & development
care.body: After launch we keep the site or app running, fix bugs and add features. Even if someone else built it.

Drawings.title: Projects we have worked on.
Drawings.lead: Client sites and a product of our own. Click a name to open it live.

kromka.result: Shop connected to their CRM and ERP

zwicker.result: Multilingual site with a Payload CMS admin

heystol.result: Guests can prepay, and the money goes straight to the venue

Products.title: Products we build and run ourselves.

heystol.body: Table bookings and seats for events such as tastings or workshops, all on one link. Guests can pay when they book, and the money goes straight to the venue's account, not through us.

okfaktura.body: For companies that settle invoices with several contractors every month. The system drafts each contractor's invoice, the contractor confirms it, and the IBAN and VAT details are checked before it goes out. Your accountant gets the whole month's documents at once.

Studio.title: Roman Denysov, founder.
Studio.body: Software engineer based in Košice. [N] years building React and React Native products for teams from local restaurants to international companies. You talk to the person who draws the options and writes the code.
